summary: 织布效率提高造成纱线短缺，哈格里夫斯设计了可同时纺多根线的珍妮纺纱机。后来的机型越来越大，生产逐渐从家庭作坊转入工厂，也改变了纺工的工作。
logic: 织布提速造成供纱瓶颈
机型变大推动工厂生产
讨论生产力与工人处境

paragraphs.brief: 工业革命直到1820年代才到达美国，从东北部的纺织工业开始。
sentences: The Industrial Revolution (1760–1850) began in England and spread throughout Europe and the Americas over the course of the next several decades.
工业革命(1760-1850年)始于英国，并在未来几十年中蔓延到欧洲和美洲。
The Industrial Revolution did not reach America until the 1820s and began with the textile industries in the Northeast.
工业革命直到1820年代才到达美国，从东北部的纺织工业开始。
Expanding technology and the invention of new machines forever changed the way manufacturing and industry took place.
技术的扩大和新机器的发明永远改变了制造和工业的发生方式。
The textile industry was greatly impacted by a number of new inventions such as the flying shuttle, the spinning frame and the cotton gin.
纺织业受到一些新发明的严重影响，如航天飞机、旋转框架和棉花杜松子酒。
But it was the invention of the Spinning Jenny by James Hargreaves that is credited with moving the textile industry from homes to factories.
但James Hargreaves发明的"旋转珍妮" 被归功于将纺织业从家迁到工厂
The move from a domestic, cottage-based industry to factories allowed the expansion of the Industrial Revolution from England throughout much of the world.
从家庭工业向工厂的转变使得工业革命从英国扩展到世界大部分地区。

paragraphs.brief: 将原材料运到许多地点，等待用手制成的纺织品，然后将成品运回商家，也是一种寻找替代物的动力。
sentences: James Hargreaves was a weaver in Blackburn, Lancashire.
詹姆斯·哈格瑞夫斯是兰卡西雷的布莱克本的编织工
Although this area was known as a major textile center, prior to the Industrial Revolution the production of cloth from raw goods took place within cottage industries.
虽然该地区被称为主要纺织中心，但在工业革命之前，从原材料生产布料是在家庭工业中进行的。
All work was done by individuals within the home, and entire families were involved.
所有工作都由个人在家里完成，全家都参与其中。
Men were often the weavers, while children assisted in cleaning raw materials and women spun the materials into threads or yarns.
男子往往是编织者，而儿童则协助清洗原材料，妇女则将材料插进线条或线条。
The process was time-consuming, and merchants wanting to meet the demand for textile goods were often frustrated by the huge gap between supply and demand.
这一过程耗费时间，希望满足纺织品需求的商人往往因供求之间的巨大差距而受挫。

The expense involved in transporting raw materials to numerous locations, waiting for finished textiles to be made by hand, and then the finished goods to be picked up and transported back to the merchant was also an incentive to search for alternatives.
将原材料运到许多地点，等待用手制成的纺织品，然后将成品运回商家，也是一种寻找替代物的动力。

While the invention of the flying shuttle and later the power loom made it possible to weave materials faster, the spinning of raw materials into threads and yarns was still done by hand, one thread at a time.
虽然航天飞机的发明以及后来的动力使材料编织速度加快，但原材料转成线条和线条的工作仍然是手工完成的，每次只有一条线。
Spinners were unable to keep up with the increased demand for threads.
螺旋桨无法跟上对线条的需求增加。

paragraphs.brief: James Hargreaves可能设计了旋转的Jenny 来改进托马斯高中在1763年或1764年发明的机器
sentences: James Hargreaves may have designed the spinning jenny as an improvement over an earlier machine invented by Thomas High in 1763 or 1764.
James Hargreaves可能设计了旋转的Jenny 来改进托马斯高中在1763年或1764年发明的机器
While never patented, High’s machine used six spinning wheels that were bolted together and powered by a single large wheel.
高架机虽然从未申请专利，但使用六个旋转轮，这些旋转轮被一个大的轮子固定在一起，并用一个大的轮儿充电。
James Hargreaves’ spinning jenny was said to have been designed after he saw his wife’s spinning wheel knocked over and saw the spindle continue to spin.
据说James Hargreaves的旋转Jenny是在他看到妻子的旋转轮被翻转，看到螺旋继续旋转后设计的。
The spinning jenny used eight different spindles that were powered by a single wheel.
旋转的Jenny用了八个不同的螺旋由一个方向盘驱动
This allowed one spinster to produce eight threads in the same amount of time that it previously took to produce one.
这使得一个脊柱能产生八条线，与以前生产一条线所用的时间相同。

paragraphs.brief: 这导致了工厂的走向，在这些工厂里，这些大型机器可以由较少的工人操作。
sentences: Later versions of the spinning jenny added even more spindles, which made the machine too large for home use.
后来版本的旋转Jenny 添加了更多的螺旋，这使得机器太大供家庭使用。
This led the way to factories where these larger machines could be run by fewer workers.
这导致了工厂的走向，在这些工厂里，这些大型机器可以由较少的工人操作。
With machines and workers concentrated in one place, the transportation costs of raw materials and finished goods were greatly reduced.
机器和工人集中在一个地方，原材料和制成品的运输费用大大减少。
Factory owners also had greater control over workers and began a division of labor that had individuals responsible for different stages of the manufacturing process.
工厂业主对工人的控制也更大，并开始分工，由个人负责制造过程的不同阶段。
This led to increased production and often a demand for workers to keep up with quotas set by the factory owners.
这导致产量增加，而且工人往往需要跟上工厂业主规定的配额。

The invention of the spinning jenny and other inventions that improved the efficiency and production of textiles were the beginning of the Industrial Revolution that shifted England, Europe, and the United States from agrarian societies to industrial economies.
欧洲和美国，从农业社会到工业经济：“改变英国的工业革命的开始包括提高纺织品效率和生产效率的旋转珍妮发明和其他发明。”

paragraphs.brief: 早期的转动Jenny也产生了比手能产生的线条更弱的线条，因此，在改进机器和提供可靠电力源之前，质量有所下降。
sentences: As with all change, there were advantages and disadvantages to the use of the spinning jenny and other inventions at the time.
和所有的变化一样，使用旋转珍妮和其他发明的优点和缺点。
The spinning jenny allowed more threads and yarns to be produced by fewer spinners.
旋转的珍妮允许更多的线条和线条由更少的旋翼人生产。

The early spinning jenny also produced a weaker thread than could be produced by hand, so there was a decrease in quality until improvements were made to the machines and a dependable power source became available.
早期的转动Jenny也产生了比手能产生的线条更弱的线条，因此，在改进机器和提供可靠电力源之前，质量有所下降。
With the use of water to power later versions of spinning and weaving machinery, the quality and strength of the cloth produced were greatly improved.
随着用水为后来的旋转和编织机器提供动力，所生产的布的质量和强度大大提高。

While many factors in England, including the availability of workers along with the increased demand for textiles, produced ideal conditions for the economic growth of the textile industry, without the invention of the spinning jenny, progress would have continued at a much slower pace.
虽然英格兰的许多因素，包括工人的可获性以及对纺织品的需求增加，为纺织业的经济增长创造了理想的条件，但没有旋转的珍妮的发明，进展本会继续缓慢得多。

paragraphs.brief: 传统的说法是，“旋涡珍妮”是以Hargreave的女儿或妻子的名字命名的。
sentences: A traditional story maintains that the Spinning Jenny was named after one of Hargreaves’ daughters or his wife.
传统的说法是，“旋涡珍妮”是以Hargreave的女儿或妻子的名字命名的。
Yet he had no daughter named Jenny, and his wife was named Elizabeth.
但他没有女儿叫珍妮他的妻子叫伊丽莎白
The word jenny is an old word used as a reference to an engine.
Jenny这个词是旧词用来作为引擎的参考

There is some indication that James Hargreaves worked with Thomas High to improve on an earlier invention of a mechanical spinning wheel and improved the design, which was then named a spinning jenny after Thomas High’s daughter.
有迹象表明，James Hargreaves与Thomas High合作，改进了早先发明的机械旋转车轮，并改进了设计，后来将其命名为以ThomaS High的女儿为旋转车。
Regardless of how the invention came to be named, it changed forever the way textile manufacturing was accomplished and led the way to the Industrial Revolution.
不管发明是如何命名的，它永远改变了纺织制造业的实现方式，并引导着工业革命。

clauses: But it was the invention of the Spinning Jenny by James Hargreaves ….
“that is credited with moving the textile industry from homes to factories”修饰前面的 invention。先认出先行词，再读从句补充的特征。
读到 that 时，回看 invention，再把修饰信息接回主句。
…, prior to the Industrial Revolution the production of cloth from raw goods took place within cottage industries.
连接词 although 引出“Although this area was known as a major textile center”，说明主句的让步关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 although 把这一层关系补进去。
